text.p: Liverpool of England beat Brann Bergen of Norway 3-0 (halftime 1-0) in their European Cup Winners' Cup quarter-final second leg match on Thursday.
Scorers: Robbie Fowler pen 25, 78, Stan Collymore 62

Liverpool: 1-David James; 5-Mark Wright, 21-Dominic Matteo (6-Phil Babb 46), 12-Steve Harkness, 4-Jason McAteer, 20-Stig Inge Bjornebye, 7-Steve McManaman, 10-John Barnes, 11-Jamie Redknapp, 9-Robbie Fowler, 15-Patrick Berger (8-Stan Collymore 60)

Brann Bergen: 24-Vidar Bahus; 18-Morten Pedersen, 3-Claus Eftevaag (17-Agust Gylfason 44), 16-Per Ove Ludvigsen, 26-Stefan Paldan, 6-Eirik Skjaelaaen (19-Erik Johannessen 86), 5-Roger Helland, 8-Geir Hasund (2-Cato Guntveit 66), 27-Arne Vidar Moen, 9-Tore Andre Flo, 22-Mons Ivar Mjelde.
